feature_contract.goal: Preserve stage +TIME sprite and numeric glyph stereo GPU ownership by refusing a captured original-game c64 matrix from another physical vertex shader or shader generation, while retaining native fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R84 +TIME physical c64 source validation for exact original StageExtensionTime; do not relabel unrelated GOAL/rank/world/lens HUD or alter native input, FFB, SkyGlow, D3D9 fallback, R26_SAFE, independent DX11 or frozen DXVK. HMD optics remain untested.
trace_stages: Six original game +TIME stage extension sprite and numeric E8 producers retain existing exact Source/ScreenHud, SpriteNode and D3DX deferred batch owners.
During R84 R33 shader HUD physical draw, captureStageSource reads the current vertex shader identity/epoch and the ORIGINAL raw game c64 write metadata, not private stereo eye uploads.

Require captured game c64 owner shader and epoch to match this physical draw before a left-eye submission; then existing left/right eye physical-source, pose, target and restore fences remain authoritative. Missing capture uses conservative existing native fallback.
The original x64 OpenXR host eye presentation and actual Quest3 optical acceptance remain separate runtime tests.
subcomponents: Implement a source-coherent original-game raw c64 shader and shader-epoch admission predicate that refuses known foreign and incomplete writes, while retaining the missing-tracker fallback.
Integrate that predicate in the real R84 R33 +TIME GPU source capture before left-eye submission without changing GOAL, WorldBillboard, SkyGlow or game simulation.
Compile positive and negative C++ source-header assertions covering exact shader identity, foreign shader, stale generation, partial write, unknown capture and original unbound shader.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A +TIME banner and numeral draw with known original raw c64 provenance may proceed only with identical physical vertex shader identity and generation; foreign c64 cannot drive either eye.

Missing raw-tracker data keeps the existing conservative unknown fallback; stale shader epoch, mismatched identity, zero source serial or partial captured write refuse stereo ownership without changing original native input, FFB, SkyGlow or R26_SAFE.
The exact final result SHA must pass DX9Ex Active Windows game and x64 host/package, Domain Isolation, EXE HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact gates; Quest3 optics separately remain untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R33 captureStageSource recorded rawShader/rawShaderEpoch from GetLastRawGameWvpWrite but did not compare them with the current physical shader/epoch, collapsing unmatched captured c64 into valid +TIME source.
diagnosis.root_cause: The original-game c64 write tracker could describe a previous world/GOAL shader even when the physical +TIME shader owner differs. This is a static provenance vulnerability, not evidence of an observed Quest3 failure.
source_trace: Exact StageExtensionTime native sprite and numeric producers are already admitted and tagged through hooks_uiscaling and bounded SpriteNode/D3DX queue ownership.
R84 R33 captures original raw c64 serial and shader generation before native +TIME left-eye dispatch; known foreign source is rejected before left submission.
R84 R33 still applies existing shader/pose/queue/physical left-right checks and restores game state, then x64 host performs its distinct OpenXR composition.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both R84 physical eye submissions require original shader-coherent StageExtensionTime c64 source when captured, with existing per-eye state restore and hardware acceptance independent.
alternatives_rejected: Do not blindly convert a captured foreign shader write to missing-evidence fallback.
Do not widen +TIME provenance across GOAL/rank or infer HMD correctness from CI.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Real R84 source material commit 6efddfc1943bc28c17c5ff1cc78a312b7c888e59 changed source admission before native GPU draw.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Compile-time static_assert cases in real R84 included header for shader mismatch, epoch mismatch, zero serial, absent capture and valid identity; exact Windows build pending.

prior_failed_runs.cause: Active policy requires exact current TASK_ID JSON and did not reach x86 game or x64 host build

ci_evidence.local_targeted_gate: R84 game header static_assert shader/epoch/serial positive and negative tests compiled in Windows full-chain exact-SHA job
